standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherence of the complexes involved

standard_prerequisites.use: The displayed maps live in D_QCoh(O_X'), making the base-change condition meaningful.

standard_prerequisites.name: Transitive property of the tensor product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Algebra, lemma triple-tensor-product (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Computes source and target of the base-change map in case (1).

standard_prerequisites.name: Preparation of the fancy base-change map
standard_prerequisites.use: First arrow of the composition used in cases (2) and (3).

core_obligations: Case (1): compute both sides of the base-change map using the triple tensor product; the condition for K identifies L(g')^*(E tensor K) -> L(g')^*E tensor K' as a base change of an isomorphism.

Cases (2) and (3): the map is the composition L(g')^*R SheafHom(E, K) -> R SheafHom(L(g')^*E, L(g')^*K) -> R SheafHom(L(g')^*E, K'), the first arrow from the fancy base-change remark, the second from the given map L(g')^*K -> K'.
In case (2) represent the stalks of E by bounded complexes of finite projective modules; in case (3) by bounded above complexes of finite free modules.
Compute source and target of the base-change map against these representatives; the source ends 'Some details omitted' - carry the term-by-term computation as an explicit obligation.
proof_roadmap: Quasi-coherence setup; tensor case via triple product; internal-Hom composition; finite-projective representatives; computation obligation.
difficulty_reason: A three-case inheritance argument with a real computation in cases (2) and (3); the waved term-by-term check is carried as an obligation.
